body:
I tried Mirtazapine because I decided to experiment with different drugs after having tried Cannabis and Methylphenidate (Ritalin) with good experiences.  This is my second time using Mirtazapine.  The first time I took 15mg, but it didn't really do much.
I took half of a 30 mg pill around 4:00 at night, and then I took the other half about 30 minutes later.  I started feeling kinda weird around 5:00, colors seemed yellowish and I couldn't really concentrate on anything very hard.  I started getting sleepy, and around 5:30 i fell asleep.  I didn't wake up until about 12:00 in the afternoon the next day.  I still felt weird and I still couldn't concentrate on things, but the yellowish tinge was gone.  I had a basketball game I had to play in at 9:00 and while playing I couldn't remember which side I was guarding and It was hard to play.  Although I was asleep throughout the main experience, the after effects were very strong and kept me from doing anything that required concentration.
